Merge Prior and New Results

Source: R/resume.R
merge_results.Rd

Combines results from a resumed run with new results from continued execution. Duplicate task rows must be identical or an integrity error is raised.

Usage

merge_results(prior_results, new_results)

Arguments

prior_results

Data frame of results from checkpoint.

new_results

Data frame of results from new execution.

Value

Combined data frame with unique task_id values.

Details

If both inputs are NULL or empty, returns NULL. If only one input has data, returns that input. Otherwise, removes any task_ids from prior_results that appear in new_results, then combines.
